description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_DisableExternal, which extends HTMLPurifier_URIFilter. It implements a filter to disable external URI references that do not match the host of the current configuration's URI, effectively blocking external links based on host comparison.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_DisableExternal
classes.description: A URI filter class that blocks external links unless they match the host of the configured URI.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the filter by extracting the host from the configuration and dividing it into parts for comparison.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Determines if a given URI should be allowed based on its host matching the configured host parts.
